title: a replaced line keeps neighbouring pauses and music automation; a different voice invalidates neighbour assumptions

old.text: Make a whole film from one sentence.

next.text: Make an entire film from one sentence.

expect.base: old lead 0.1 s / trail 0.2 s, new lead 0.3 s / trail 0.05 s, duration 2.6 -> 3.0: duration_delta_s +0.4; timing_proposal {shot_id 'shot-2', duration_delta_s 0.4, via commitTiming} (never retimed in place); music_automation shift_after_s 0.4 (the duck envelope is re-derived by duckEnvelope, not stretched). Head: the new clip carries 0.2 s more leading silence, so action trim_or_pad_head of -0.2 s needs a head handle of 0.3 s (present) and keeps the pause after line-01 at 0.5 s. Tail: 0.15 s less trailing silence is padded (positive slide) -> trim_or_pad_tail +0.15 s keeps the pause before line-03 at 0.6 s. ok true
expect.different_voice: issue voice-differs and neighbours_recheck true: level, pace and room tone of the neighbours were set against the old voice and are not assumed to match
expect.sample_rate_mismatch: issues sample-rate and channel-layout; ok false until the clip is conformed to the stem's layout
expect.unmeasured: a segment with duration_s null: issue duration-unmeasured and timing_proposal null (unknown, not zero)

note: prev and after only need to be present: they say there ARE neighbours whose pauses must be kept
